answer: Five jurors, five separate operators. Score each answer 0 to 3. Disagreement beyond one point voids the panel and slashes the outlier. Standing expires unless fresh work renews it, so last month's crystal reputation cannot be rented out. Every submission carries a new nonce. A prism splits one input into five readings and the panel must not, while the mirror exposes a juror grading its own clone as a flat line. Cost: five operators per fake verdict, re-earned each epoch.
